---
title: "Accessibility diagnostics demo"
---

This page deliberately contains accessibility problems so the preview's client-side
a11y audit has something to flag in the dev-menu panel. Each located finding (the
ones tied to a block) jumps to its source line on click, like any other diagnostic.

## A section with a raw image

<img src="logo.png">

The raw `<img>` above has no `alt` attribute, so a screen reader can't describe it
(a decorative image should use `alt=""`).

#### A subsection that skips a heading level

This heading is an `h4` directly under the `h2` above, skipping `h3`.

Here is [](#) — a link with no text, so it has no accessible name.
